correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive exact proof. Direct synchronous-infection enumeration checks all seeds up to optimum sizes 3 and 4; a second coordinate-subcube merger procedure independently enumerates the same accepted seed lists with exactly matching 256-bit digests. Every token-exchange adjacency is constructed, and breadth-first distances from representatives of all 2 and 18 full cube-isometry orbits determine every eccentricity. The two separately coded methods recover matching full seed counts, graph edge totals, connectivity and Q4/Q5 jump/slide radius-diameter values; the Q5 slide histogram 960/11200/4800 is exact. Both programs and their outputs replay from their complete included paths. This is a finite computational proof, not an infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Exact exchange relations, connectivity, radius/diameter and 960/11200/4800 eccentricity spectrum of minimum threshold-two seed sets for Q4 and Q5 are not consequences of cited random critical-threshold results, minimum-size bounds, or projection-closure principles. Actual semantic mathematical-record database searches, published primary-text comparisons, plausible aliases and previous own claims were checked. The strongest overlap is the general internally-spanned projection framework; its implications stop short of fixed-budget exchange-graph distances. An uninspected 2006 body and unindexed literature remain honest risks.
residual_risks: The full text of the 2006 Balogh–Bollobás antecedent was not available for complete inspection; its accessible abstract discusses random thresholds, not exchange graphs.

Available sections of 2009, 2015 and 2024 papers and their searchable text were inspected, not every line of every appendix; no claim of worldwide priority certainty is made.

value.rationale: Minimum spreading sets of the cube under a fixed seed budget are naturally motivated by irreversible activation and minimal intervention designs. Restricting exchanges to adjacent cube vertices is a canonical geometric movement model; unlike mere existence/minimum-size questions, the theorem resolves entire optimal-state reachability, worst-case movement budgets and which states minimize them. The transition from self-centered Q4 slide dynamics to a Q5 graph with 960 central and 4800 peripheral states is a substantive geometric phenomenon. The exact 16960-state example is large enough to make nontrivial certificates and supplies an informative boundary, without claiming a general dimension theorem.
